briefs.objective: Develop a reproducible search that captures all primary studies evaluating LLMs for title/abstract screening against human reviewers.
briefs.guidance: Combine LLM names (GPT‑4, Claude, LLaMA) with screening terms ("title screening", "abstract selection"). Exclude generic AI or full‑text extraction papers. Beware synonyms like "machine learning" that may not refer to LLMs. Use health databases and preprint servers.

briefs.objective: Obtain full‑text PDFs for every record retrieved by the search.
briefs.guidance: Prioritize open‑access sources; request PDFs via institutional links. Flag conference abstracts and pay‑walled items for possible exclusion. Verify that each document contains methods describing LLM screening of titles/abstracts.

briefs.objective: Rapidly filter records to retain only studies meeting inclusion criteria.
briefs.guidance: Reject obvious non‑primary reports, editorials, or studies on full‑text tasks. Watch for ambiguous terms like "AI screening" that may refer to risk‑of‑bias tools. Ensure the population is systematic‑review records, not simulated datasets.

briefs.objective: Confirm eligibility by detailed review of full texts.
briefs.guidance: Exclude papers lacking a human comparator or quantitative accuracy metrics. Beware studies that only report qualitative LLM performance. Note if the LLM is used for a hybrid workflow, which may render metrics incomparable.

briefs.objective: Extract accuracy outcomes and study characteristics for meta‑analysis.
briefs.guidance: Hard‑to‑find items: confidence intervals for sensitivity/specificity, exact LLM version, and number of reviewers. Record whether screening was single‑ or dual‑reviewer. Non‑comparable studies often use different reference standards or thresholds.

briefs.objective: Summarize pooled accuracy estimates and assess heterogeneity.
briefs.guidance: Separate diagnostic‑accuracy designs from RCTs. Highlight variability due to LLM version, dataset size, or human reviewer expertise. Discuss bias from selective reporting of favorable metrics.

briefs.objective: Verify that all stages meet protocol standards and data are error‑free.
briefs.guidance: Cross‑check extracted numbers against source PDFs. Ensure inclusion decisions match criteria. Confirm that JSON outputs are syntactically valid and that no duplicate records remain.
